plan.title: Reject proposal with empty Recommended Supplier 1

steps.note: Open Master QCS for the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case setup.
Enter the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor B as specified.
Verify the full line is allocated to one vendor and the proposal value is 10 × 90 = 900.
Open the proposal form after the allocation.

args.goal: On the proposal form, fill every required field except Recommended Supplier 1, leave Recommended Supplier 1 empty, and click Submit Proposal; stop when the form shows the required-field validation.

steps.note: Perform the proposal-form completion and deliberately omit the named required field.
Verify submission was refused and the omitted field is highlighted with the required-field message.
